newsitem.title: USA: Leslie's gets buy offer from Hancock Park.
newsitem.headline: Leslie's gets buy offer from Hancock Park.

text.p: Leslie's Poolmart Inc said Tuesday that Hancock Park Associates II LP is offering to buy it in a cash merger for $14.50 per share.
Hancock Park is a partnership consisting of Michael Fourticq, Hancock's chairman, and Brian McDermott, its chief executive, Leslie's said.
Leslie's said it has also received preliminary indications of acquisition interest from two other firms in a cash-for-shares transaction for equal to or less than the Hancock Park offer.
Leslie's, a retailer of pool supplies, closed trading Monday at 11-1/2 per share.
The company said it has about 6.55 million common shares outstanding and 960,000 shares subject to employee and director stock options.
The company said a special committee of its board will consider the Hancock Park offer, the two indications of interest and any other proposals.

The committee is comprised of two new members of its board, Dann Angeloff, president of a Los Angeles financial advisory firm, and Clarence Schmitz, executive vice president of Los Angeles investment banking firm, Leslie's said.
The company said Murray Dashe has resigned as a director but will remain as chief operating officer.
